newsitem.title: USA: Most IMM currency futures lower, mark near lows.
newsitem.headline: Most IMM currency futures lower, mark near lows.

text.p: July 8 - IMM currency futures were mostly lower in afternoon dealings, with yen giving back earlier gains as market awaits the release of Japan's May current account data at 2350 GMT. Marks were hovering above the contract low of $0.5707 set earlier on a six-year peak in spot pound/mark and worries about a soft single European currency, traders said.
